organization_note: Writer, Inc., whose newsroom gives its headquarters at 111 Maiden Lane, San Francisco, takes legal notices there, and its terms are governed by California law. It develops the Palmyra models and serves them through its developer platform. One name, Writer, covers the models in the catalog. The company's careers page says it runs a hybrid culture of in-office and remote work, and names three offices, San Francisco, New York, and London. Two are in the United States, which is the headquarters; the third is the organization's work outside it.
